name: Fathom
auth_type: REST: API Key (Bearer). MCP: Personal Access Token (PAT).
credential_access: Self-serve API key in User Settings → API Access. Note: Developer docs list https://api.fathom.ai/mcp, while current Help Center lists https://api.fathom.dev/mcp (re-verify endpoint at connection time).
audit_confidence: High (Endpoint URL discrepancy noted between dev docs and support)
winner: Gemini closer on API; both missed vendor-hosted MCP
evidence_notes: Official Fathom docs & Help Centre confirm vendor-hosted MCP. Developer docs list api.fathom.ai/mcp while support lists api.fathom.dev/mcp.

name: Pumble
auth_type: REST: API Key (ApiKey header). MCP: App key (x-app-token) + user or bot token.
credential_access: REST API key via workspace Configure Apps (all plans). Native MCP setup configured via Workspace Settings → Apps.
winner: Both AI failed MCP (Pumble officially launched native Pumble MCP Server)
evidence_notes: Official Pumble Help Center documents native Pumble MCP Server requiring App key (x-app-token) plus user or bot token.

name: Grain
auth_type: REST: Bearer Token. MCP: Personal Access Token (PAT).
credential_access: PAT: self-serve via integrations page for MCP. Other token/OAuth scopes require workspace-specific client verification.
audit_confidence: High for MCP / PAT (WAT & OAuth scopes require direct client confirmation)
winner: Gemini closer on API; both missed native MCP at api.grain.com/_/mcp
evidence_notes: Grain confirms public API and official MCP server at api.grain.com/_/mcp authenticated via PAT.

name: Otter.ai
auth_type: REST: Bearer Token (Enterprise only). MCP: In-product connection (no public API key).
credential_access: Public REST API is Enterprise-plan gated (10 req/sec limit). Official MCP is available via in-product setup for AI clients (no standalone public API key).
verified_verdict: Gated for REST API / Official MCP Available
winner: Perplexity correct on REST API enterprise gate; both missed official Otter MCP server
evidence_notes: Public REST API requires Enterprise plan. Official Otter MCP Server exists, but setup docs state there is no public API key.

name: WhatsApp Business
auth_type: Bearer access token via OAuth authorization flow (System User for permanent production).
credential_access: Sandbox: instant temporary token in Meta App. Production: Permanent access requires System User with business_management and whatsapp_business_messaging permissions; business verification may apply.
audit_confidence: High (Primary Meta Cloud API & MCP documentation confirmed)
winner: Perplexity closer on production controls; official WhatsApp MCP active at mcp.facebook.com/whatsapp_business_tools
evidence_notes: Permanent token requires System User with specific permissions. Official Meta MCP endpoint live at mcp.facebook.com/whatsapp_business_tools.

name: Google Ads
auth_type: Application Default Credentials (ADC) / OAuth 2.0 (stdio or Cloud Run HTTP).
credential_access: Google Cloud project with Google Ads API enabled. Test access: instant. Production: Cloud project approval tier. Google sunset developer tokens Sept 9, 2026.
audit_confidence: High (Primary Google documentation confirms sunset and official MCP)
winner: Both AI cited sunset developer tokens; human audit confirmed official google-ads-mcp package and Cloud access tiers
evidence_notes: Google confirms developer tokens were sunset on Sept 9, 2026. Official google-ads-mcp package available for stdio and Cloud Run.

name: Notion
auth_type: REST: Bearer Token (Internal connection or PAT). MCP: OAuth authorization & MCP tokens.
credential_access: Self-serve in Developer portal (app.notion.com/developers/connections). Hosted remote MCP server at mcp.notion.com/mcp supports OAuth.
audit_confidence: High (Primary docs confirm official hosted MCP at mcp.notion.com/mcp)
winner: Gemini correct on official MCP; Perplexity falsely claimed community-only
evidence_notes: Notion developer docs explicitly document official remote MCP at mcp.notion.com/mcp; open-source local server deprecated.

name: Stripe
auth_type: REST: Secret Key (sk_live/test) / Restricted Keys. MCP: OAuth authorization flow.
credential_access: REST: instant self-serve keys in Stripe Dashboard. MCP: official server at mcp.stripe.com connects via OAuth account authorization (CLI setup via stripe agent setup).
audit_confidence: High (Primary docs confirm official MCP at mcp.stripe.com with OAuth)
winner: Gemini correct on official MCP existence; Perplexity missed vendor-hosted endpoint
evidence_notes: Stripe documents official MCP server at https://mcp.stripe.com with OAuth connection. API secret keys belong to REST, not primary MCP flow.

name: Slack

audit_confidence: High (Primary docs confirm remote MCP at mcp.slack.com/mcp and Slackbot client)
winner: Both AI accurate on core REST API; human audit confirmed official remote MCP at mcp.slack.com/mcp
evidence_notes: Slack documents official remote MCP server at https://mcp.slack.com/mcp. Workspace-admin approval may be required before connection.
